descriptionChirho: A species of locust (collective singular chasil), consistently portrayed as an agent of agricultural devastation; the word appears exclusively in contexts of plague, crop destruction, and divine judgment, paralleling other locust terms (yeleq, arbeh, gazam); identified variously as the caterpillar or consuming locust stage (1 Kgs 8:37; 2 Chr 6:28; Ps 78:46; Isa 33:4; Joel 1:4; 2:25).
